title: OpenStreetMap Integration — Decentralized Map Data Distribution

requirements.summary: Fetch the Geofabrik index and display predefined regions with version and country/subregion level.
Host workflow: Geofabrik PBF -> Logos Storage -> on-chain OSM registry.
Download hosted regions from Logos Storage, otherwise direct-fallback to Geofabrik; hosted-file trust comes from CID integrity.
Bulk host multiple predefined non-overlapping regions with per-region opt-out; warn on parent/child overlap if extra non-partition regions are exposed.
Local PBF import verifies Geofabrik MD5 at import time, then stores and registers by CID.
Compare central Geofabrik versions with registry per region path and notify about updates.
On-chain LEZ OSM registry stores required region metadata, uses Geofabrik path identity, supports query by region/parent/CID, and batch registration.
OSM registry operates end-to-end on Logos testnet 0.3.
Self-contained OSM registry Basecamp SDK/module has stable documented API, minimal embedding example, full API for the distribution app, and is independently publishable.
Provide a Logos Basecamp GUI with local build instructions, downloadable assets, and loadability in Basecamp.
SDK/module can be used by other Basecamp apps/modules, with published API docs and a minimal standalone embedding example.
CLI covers host, batch-register, lookup by region/parent/CID, update check, download, and local import.
UX clearly shows hosted/not-hosted state, version numbers, and verification results.
Storage uploads retry transient failures with exponential backoff and surface a clear final error.
Import-time checksum failure is graceful and clearly explained.
Registry entries are ordered by timestamp for version sorting.

No mandatory centralized services beyond permitted Logos components and Geofabrik roles; optional third-party services are disclosed/disableable; hosted regions work without Geofabrik; analytics opt-in only.
Document cycle-count usage for register and batch-register on-chain operations.
Deploy and test against the canonical Logos testnet 0.3 zone.
Build and run end-to-end on macOS Apple Silicon and Linux x86_64.
Distribution app and SDK/module are built with logos-module-builder using mkLogosModule.
Publish Basecamp modules to a module catalog fork using logos-modules-release-action and provide logos-repo.json URL.
Generate and provide the OSM registry IDL with SPEL.
End-to-end host -> query -> download integration tests run against a real standalone sequencer and are in green default-branch CI.
README documents setup, deployed program ID, region list, and step-by-step CLI/Basecamp usage.
SDK docs include a worked example resolving region to CID and metadata.
Cover at least 15 countries and 25 total verified region entries on official Logos testnet 0.3 with Logos Storage bytes matching Geofabrik MD5.
At least 5 genuinely independent modules, including at least 3 Basecamp UI modules, consume the OSM distribution/SDK with public genuine commit history and inspectable code use.
Redundant mirroring: covered region hosted by more than 5 distinct operators.
evidence: same CID hosted by distinct accounts

requirements.summary: Community vouching from people who actually hosted or used a region, with real account history.
Public implementation repository contains registry, SDK/module, CLI, and distribution Basecamp app and is dual licensed MIT + Apache-2.0.
Provide registry IDL and deployed Logos testnet 0.3 program ID.
Provide module-catalog release and logos-repo.json URL installable through package manager/lgpd.
Provide evidence for required adoption: independent module links and on-chain region/CID coverage sufficient for evaluator verification.
Provide FURPS self-assessment in the solution submission.
A solution PR in logos-co/lambda-prize is required to claim the prize; first qualifying solution PR wins under the observed rules.
Maximum 3 submissions per prize and at most one submission/review per week under observed program rules.

scopeConstraints.summary: On-chain OSM registry register/batch/query built with SPEL.
PBF snapshots in Logos Storage; Geofabrik canonical for index/import checksums/unhosted fallback.
Host workflow including bulk host and local import.
Region discovery/update check limited to predefined non-overlapping set.
Distribution Basecamp app, SDK/module, and CLI.
Custom regions or extra tree levels for prize coverage.
Hosted relay/backend; logic should run on permitted Logos stack components.

eligibility.summary: Open to individual or team; submission must be original work and submitters hold rights to submitted code.
Submitted implementation must be dual licensed MIT and Apache-2.0.

closedRegionSet.rule: Frozen non-overlapping leaf set from the observed LP-0018 source. Country files for US, India, China, and Russia are excluded; listed subregions represent them.

notes: This file is a traceability artifact, not a substitute for the canonical LP-0018 specification.
Refresh and diff the canonical source before submission or when upstream changes are suspected.
A requirement may be internally verified without being externally accepted by Logos.
